offer.text: Some of our folk have lost their trade and their spirits. Go speak with 3 of the idle ones — just listen.

accept.text: Kindness is the only sermon that matters. Off you go.

decline.text: Loneliness will keep until you have time for it.

in_progress.text: Have you sat with the lost souls yet?

ready.text: Three hearts a little lighter for your visit. Bless you.

complete.text: You tend souls as well as any cleric. Thank you, truly.
